result.title: A Parameter-Free Best-of-Both-Worlds Policy for Queueing Bandits
result.summary: We study online channel scheduling for a single queue served by $K$ channels under bandit feedback. We propose a simple best-of-both-worlds policy that explores when the queue is empty. During busy periods, it selects the empirical best channel while the prescribed conditions hold and, if any condition is violated, switches to a robust bandit policy to clear the queue. For arbitrary arrivals and services determined by an oblivious adversary, our policy achieves $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K L_T})$ worst-case queue length regret with high probability, where $L_T$ is the longest busy-period length. This result improves the previous $T^{3/4}$ dependence and matches the worst-case lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Under bounded i.i.d. stochastic models with a unique best stabilizing channel, we show that the cumulative queue length regret converges to a finite problem-dependent constant, and further establish the logarithmic expected worst-case queue length regret bound.

AI.brief_summary: 研究单队列、K 条信道的 bandit 在线调度，提出无参数 best-of-both-worlds 策略：队列空闲时探索，忙碌期在条件满足时选经验最优信道、否则切换到鲁棒 bandit 策略，并给出最坏情形约 O(√(K·L_T)) 的队列长度 regret 及随机模型下的常数与对数 regret。
AI.relevance_reason: 以队列积压这一状态量触发「探索/利用」策略切换并同时给出最坏与实例相关保证，可能为 LVR 中依据未决证据或计算积压决定 THINK–LOOK–STOP 开关与动态算力分配提供概念类比，其切换条件能否迁移可供核查。
